blocks.text: The CSS Multi-column Layout Module allows easy definition of multiple columns of text - just like in newspapers:
In this chapter you will learn about the following multi-column properties:

The CSS column-count property specifies the number of columns an element should
be divided into.

The CSS column-gap property specifies the
space between the columns.
Continue learning about CSS multiple columns:
The following table lists all the multi-columns properties:

rows: Specifies the number of columns an element should be divided into
Specifies the gap between the columns
A shorthand property for setting all the column-rule-* properties
Specifies the color of the rule between columns
Specifies the style of the rule between columns
Specifies the width of the rule between columns
Specifies how many columns an element should span across
Specifies a suggested, optimal width for the columns
A shorthand property for setting column-width and column-count
